mobile.composer_input.voice.setup_needed.note: Status line under the composer after the reader taps the mic on a computer with no speech-to-text configured. Transcription runs on the computer, so the fix is there, not on the phone. Full sentence with final full stop.

mobile.composer_input.voice.mic_setup.note: Accessible name of the composer's mic when the computer has no speech-to-text configured. Screen readers only; no final full stop.

mobile.composer_input.voice.mic_setup_hi.note: Accessibility hint for the mic in its not-set-up state: what a tap does (shows how to turn voice input on). No final full stop.

mobile.composer_input.voice.discard.note: Accessible name of the ✕ in the recording row: throws the recording away and sends nothing. Distinct from finishing. No final full stop.

mobile.composer_input.voice.finish.note: Accessible name of the ✓ in the recording row: stops recording and transcribes it into the draft. No final full stop.

mobile.composer_input.voice.transcribing.note: Accessible name of the progress indicator shown while the computer transcribes the recording. No final full stop.

mobile.composer_input.paste.image.note: Visible label of a small chip in the composer that appears when the clipboard holds an image; tapping attaches it. Keep short (two words). No final full stop.

mobile.composer_input.paste.image_hint.note: Accessibility hint for the Paste image chip. No final full stop.
